boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission hangs at UNCW and nearby Wilmington public spaces.

cards.title: Browse the CAB Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Cultural Arts Building, UNCW
cards.notes: Walk through the ground-floor exhibition space, then use the posted gallery hours to plan a low-key art stop between classes.
cards.short_summary: Free public exhibitions in UNCW’s Cultural Arts Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Entrance to CAB Art Gallery exhibitions is free of charge and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours listed by UNCW are Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; summer hours differ. Check the page before going.

cards.title: See work in the Mezzanine Gallery
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Cultural Arts Building, UNCW
cards.notes: Take the stairs or elevator to the second-floor gallery and spend time with the changing student solo, group, and curated exhibits.
cards.short_summary: A separate UNCW gallery for changing student-focused exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: All Mezzanine Gallery exhibitions and lectures are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Cultural Arts Building; confirm current exhibition timing before visiting.

cards.title: Check out the Sherman Hayes Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor, UNCW Library
cards.notes: Visit the first-floor library gallery to view its rotating art or materials displays; pair it with library time or a campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A library-based UNCW gallery with public events and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Sherman Hayes Gallery events are free and open to the public, and the gallery is open whenever UNCW Library is open.
cards.access_notes: On the first floor near TAC; follow current UNCW Library opening hours.

cards.title: Hike Ev-Henwood Nature Preserve
cards.subtitle: UNCW-managed preserve near Town Creek
cards.notes: Choose a daylight walk on the preserve trails and pause at the old reservoir or logging-channel remnants described on UNCW’s trail information.
cards.short_summary: A public UNCW nature preserve for hiking, photography, and birdwatching.
cards.evidence_claim: Ev-Henwood is open to the public with no charge for admission and is open dawn to dusk, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk daily. Groups and night access have additional guidance on the UNCW page.

cards.title: Walk the Japanese Garden
cards.subtitle: New Hanover County Arboretum, 6206 Oleander Drive
cards.notes: Enter beneath the torii gateways and follow the garden’s paths past the tea house and stream at a calm, unhurried pace.
cards.short_summary: A named Arboretum garden with a tea house, dry gardens, and stream.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Hanover County Arboretum is free and open to the public daily; its Japanese Garden has a tea house, dry gardens, and a dragon-like stream.
cards.source_title: Demonstration Gardens | New Hanover County, NC
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum says it is free and open daily 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; occasional private-event closures are possible.

cards.title: Stroll the Camellia Walk
cards.subtitle: New Hanover County Arboretum, 6206 Oleander Drive
cards.notes: Follow the walk’s camellia collection and look for the Royal Velvet Camellia sculpture; return in the cooler months for seasonal blooms.
cards.short_summary: A named Arboretum walk with more than 130 camellia shrubs.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Hanover County Arboretum is free and open to the public daily, and Camellia Walk includes over 130 camellia shrubs.
cards.source_title: Demonstration Gardens | New Hanover County, NC
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum is free to visit and normally requires no ticket; daily garden hours are 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Read the Native Plant Garden displays
cards.subtitle: New Hanover County Arboretum, 6206 Oleander Drive
cards.notes: Use the educational signs and murals to identify Cape Fear-region plants, then compare the displays with what you notice around campus.
cards.short_summary: A named garden featuring local plants and educational interpretation.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Hanover County Arboretum is free and open to the public daily; its Native Plant Garden showcases Cape Fear-region plants and educational murals.
cards.source_title: Demonstration Gardens | New Hanover County, NC
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum is free to visit and normally requires no ticket; avoid dates when it is closed for a private event.

cards.title: Follow the Contemplation Garden labyrinth
cards.subtitle: New Hanover County Arboretum, 6206 Oleander Drive
cards.notes: Walk the labyrinth path beneath the five flags, keeping the visit quiet and respectful of the garden’s military-honoring purpose.
cards.short_summary: A named reflection garden with a labyrinth walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Hanover County Arboretum is free and open to the public daily; the Contemplation Garden includes a labyrinth walk beneath five flags.
cards.source_title: Demonstration Gardens | New Hanover County, NC
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum is free to visit and normally requires no ticket; daily garden hours are 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Bring a no-cost picnic to the Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Between Camellia Walk and Japanese Garden, New Hanover County Arboretum
cards.notes: Bring food from home and use the shaded picnic tables between Camellia Walk and the Japanese Garden on a first-come basis.
cards.short_summary: A first-come picnic spot inside the free county Arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is free and open to the public daily, and its shaded picnic area has first-come, first-served tables between Camellia Walk and the Japanese Garden.
cards.source_title: Visitor Etiquette | New Hanover County, NC
cards.access_notes: Tables are first-come, first-served. The Arboretum is generally open daily 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; call ahead for possible private-event closure.

cards.title: Spend time in Riverfront Park’s East Garden
cards.subtitle: Riverfront Park, downtown Wilmington
cards.notes: Use the Nutt Street Promenade entrance to reach the East Garden, then take in the riverfront setting without entering ticketed amphitheater events.
cards.short_summary: A publicly accessible garden area at Wilmington’s riverfront park.
cards.evidence_claim: Riverfront Park is open to the public from sunrise to sunset, and its East Garden is open daily, including on concert dates.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sunset except during city-approved events or programs; on concert dates, access the East Garden through Nutt Street Promenade.
